MONEY

Cash Flow Reset: 30-Day Money Sprint

Illustrated PDF Playbook + Interactive Companion App • Audience: Beginners who want simple budgeting, savings habits, and a quick money reset

MODULE 1 Page 1 of 3 • Cash Flow Reset: 30-Day Money Sprint

Page 1: Map Your Money In One Page

  • ✓ Step 1: List take-home income, fixed bills, and flexible spending
  • ✓ Step 2: Circle the three largest drains on your paycheck
  • ✓ Step 3: Set one non-negotiable weekly savings transfer
💡 Pro Action Tip: Use yesterday's numbers instead of guessing.
MODULE 2 Page 2 of 3 • Cash Flow Reset: 30-Day Money Sprint

Page 2: Run The Thirty Day Savings Challenge

  • ✓ Step 1: Start with a five dollar no-spend day
  • ✓ Step 2: Increase the challenge amount every three days
  • ✓ Step 3: Log every win on the printable tracker
💡 Pro Action Tip: Stack challenges with a weekly review.
CHEAT SHEET & WORKSHEET Page 3 of 3 • Cash Flow Reset: 30-Day Money Sprint

Page 3: Cheat Sheet And Weekly Worksheet

  • ✓ Step 1: Check subscriptions, late fees, and impulse buys
  • ✓ Step 2: Fill in the weekly spend, save, and review boxes
  • ✓ Step 3: Compare planned savings with actual results
💡 Pro Action Tip: Color only the totals; keep the sheet simple.
